findings_resolved_same_run.finding: Checkout validation compared optional productoVarianteId with > 0 and caused TS18048 in the exact-head frontend production build.
findings_resolved_same_run.root_cause: productoVarianteId is intentionally optional for backward-compatible legacy lines but the runtime/type guard only treated null as absent, not undefined.
findings_resolved_same_run.recovery: Changed the guard to accept null/undefined as legacy absence while still requiring positive safe integers when a variant id is present.

acceptance_assessment.variant_identity: Exact physical productoVarianteId now propagates from public catalog mapping through cart persistence/rehydration and checkout request/validation without conflating sibling variants.
acceptance_assessment.backward_compatibility: Legacy checkout lines without productoVarianteId remain accepted; present ids must be positive safe integers.
acceptance_assessment.ux_existing_surface: Existing storefront detail/cart flows already provide loading/error/empty states, stock handling, selector behavior, responsive UI and accessibility affordances; this microtask changes identity continuity rather than inventing a parallel UI.

causal_gate_state_at_review.remaining_relevant_frontend_regressions: terminal results required before LISTO_REAL receipt
